# Scoop + Homebrew Tap 仓库创建指南

让用户能用 `scoop install ai-agent` / `brew install ai-agent` 装 AI Agent。

## 为什么需要独立 repo？

| 工具 | 包定义位置 | 需独立 repo? | 原因 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Scoop** | `bucket/<name>.json` | ✅ 必须独立 | Scoop 强制 manifest 在独立 repo（bucket） |
| **Homebrew** | `Formula/<name>.rb` | ✅ 必须独立 | 同上，需 tap repo |
| **Docker GHCR** | 镜像名 | ❌ 在主 repo | `ghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>` 已包含命名空间 |
| **PyPI** | 项目页 | ❌ 中心化 | PyPI 自带命名空间（`pypi.org/project/<name>`） |
| **npm** | 包名 | ❌ 中心化 | 同上 |

## Scoop bucket 仓库

### 创建仓库

GitHub 上创建新 repo：**`colbertlee/scoop-bucket`**（public）

### 文件结构

```
scoop-bucket/
├── README.md
└── bucket/
    └── ai-agent.json     ← 把 .github/scoop/ai-agent.json 复制过来
```

### 创建步骤（PowerShell）

```powershell
mkdir scoop-bucket
cd scoop-bucket

# 初始化
git init
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path bucket

# 复制 manifest
Copy-Item ..\langChain_langGraph\web_console\.github\scoop\ai-agent.json bucket\ai-agent.json

# README
@"
# Scoop Bucket

Manifests for [Scoop](https://scoop.sh).

## Usage

\`\`\`powershell
scoop bucket add colbertlee https://github.com/colbertlee/scoop-bucket
scoop install ai-agent
\`\`\`
"@ | Out-File -Encoding utf8 README.md

# Commit + push
git add .
git commit -m "Initial Scoop bucket"
git remote add origin https://github.com/colbertlee/scoop-bucket.git
git push -u origin main
```

### 计算 sha256（每次 release）

```powershell
# 下载 release tarball
$TARBALL_URL = "https://github.com/colbertlee/langChain_langGraph/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.1.tar.gz"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $TARBALL_URL -OutFile "ai-agent-v0.1.1.tar.gz"

# 计算 sha256
$SHA256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 "ai-agent-v0.1.1.tar.gz").Hash
echo $SHA256
# e.g. abc123...

# 替换 manifest 的 hash + version
(Get-Content bucket\ai-agent.json) `
  -replace 'REPLACE_WITH_SHA256_OF_TARBALL', $SHA256 `
  -replace '"version": "0.1.0"', '"version": "0.1.1"' `
  -replace 'v0.1.0\.tar\.gz', 'v0.1.1.tar.gz' |
  Set-Content bucket\ai-agent.json

git add bucket\ai-agent.json
git commit -m "ai-agent: update to v0.1.1"
git push
```

### 用户安装

```powershell
# 一次性添加 bucket
scoop bucket add colbertlee https://github.com/colbertlee/scoop-bucket

# 装 ai-agent
scoop install ai-agent

# 升级
scoop update ai-agent

# 卸载
scoop uninstall ai-agent
```

## Homebrew tap 仓库

### 创建仓库

GitHub 上创建新 repo：**`colbertlee/homebrew-tap`**（public）

### 文件结构

```
homebrew-tap/
├── README.md
└── Formula/
    └── ai-agent.rb       ← 把 .github/homebrew-tap/ai-agent.rb 复制过来
```

### 创建步骤（macOS / Linux）

```bash
mkdir homebrew-tap && cd homebrew-tap
git init
mkdir Formula

# 复制 formula
cp ../langChain_langGraph/web_console/.github/homebrew-tap/ai-agent.rb Formula/ai-agent.rb

# README
cat > README.md << 'EOF'
# Homebrew Tap

Formulas for [Homebrew](https://brew.sh).

## Usage

```bash
brew tap colbertlee/tap
brew install ai-agent
```
EOF

# Commit + push
git add .
git commit -m "Initial Homebrew tap"
git remote add origin https://github.com/colbertlee/homebrew-tap.git
git push -u origin main
```

### 计算 sha256（每次 release）

```bash
TARBALL_URL="https://github.com/colbertlee/langChain_langGraph/archive/refs/tags/v0.1.1.tar.gz"
curl -L -o /tmp/ai-agent-v0.1.1.tar.gz $TARBALL_URL

SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 /tmp/ai-agent-v0.1.1.tar.gz | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "sha256: $SHA256"

# 替换 formula
cd homebrew-tap
sed -i "s/REPLACE_WITH_SHA256_OF_TARBALL/$SHA256/" Formula/ai-agent.rb
sed -i "s/v0.1.0/v0.1.1/g" Formula/ai-agent.rb

git add Formula/ai-agent.rb
git commit -m "ai-agent: update to v0.1.1"
git push
```

### 验证 formula

```bash
# 语法检查
brew audit --new Formula/ai-agent.rb

# 试装
brew install --build-from-source Formula/ai-agent.rb
brew test ai-agent
```

### 用户安装

```bash
# 一次性添加 tap
brew tap colbertlee/tap

# 装
brew install ai-agent

# 升级
brew upgrade ai-agent

# 卸载
brew uninstall ai-agent
```

---

## 自动化发布（可选）

`release.yml` workflow 可以在打 tag 后自动更新 Scoop + Brew manifest 并开 PR：

```yaml
# 加到 release.yml
update-manifests:
  name: Update Scoop + Brew Manifests
  needs: github-release
  runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  steps:
    - name: Update Scoop bucket
      uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.PAT_BOT }}    # 需配 PAT（要有 repo + workflow 权限）
        repository: colbertlee/scoop-bucket
        branch: update-ai-agent-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        title: "ai-agent: update to v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
        body: "Auto-generated by release.yml"
        # 用 sed 替换 hash + version

    - name: Update Brew tap
      uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.PAT_BOT }}
        repository: colbertlee/homebrew-tap
        branch: update-ai-agent-${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        title: "ai-agent: update to v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
        body: "Auto-generated by release.yml"
```

> ⚠️ 此自动化需要配 `PAT_BOT` secret（不能用 GITHUB_TOKEN，因为跨 repo PR）。

## 故障排查

| 现象 | 排查 |
|---|---|
| `scoop install ai-agent` 找不到 manifest | 检查 bucket repo 是否 public；manifest 路径对吗 |
| `brew install` 报 hash 不匹配 | sha256 重新算；确保没改 tarball 内容 |
| `brew audit` 报错 | 公式语法问题；按提示修复 |
| 用户装后 `ai-agent` 命令找不到 | PATH 没设；Scoop/Brew 应自动加 |
| 跨 repo PR 403 | GITHUB_TOKEN 不够；用 PAT_BOT |
